content.text: How to Watch Cardinals BroadcastsThere are multiple great ways to catch the Cardinals on TV this season! Stream games live on Cardinals.TV presented by bet365, watch via your cable or satellite provider and enjoy select games free via over-the-air TV.How to Watch Cardinals BroadcastsThere's a new way to catch the Cardinals on TV all season long! As always, you can watch Cardinals.TV presented by bet365 through your preferred TV provider, including Spectrum, DirecTV, Xfinity, Fubo, and more. StreamingWill I be able to stream Cardinals games?Yes! Cardinals.TV on MLB.TV includes access to all local Cardinals broadcasts on a variety of devices through the MLB App.How will it work and how much will it cost?Cardinals.TV in-market streaming packages can be purchased for $99.99 per year or $19.99 per month. Subscriptions for the 2026 season will be available in February.Are there any blackouts?In-market Cardinals.TV subscribers can stream ALL local Cardinals broadcasts with no blackouts. (This means all locally produced broadcasts – national TV games on ESPN, Peacock/NBC, and FOX are not available on the Cardinals.TV platform). Cardinals.TV subscribers who are outside the Cardinals home territory can still watch Cardinals games while they are travelling and are only subject to the opposing team’s local blackout restrictions, if applicable (i.e. if you're traveling in Philadelphia you would not have access to a Cardinals vs. Phillies game while in Phillies TV territory).Will I be able to watch Cardinals games if I have a standard MLB.TV package, but not the Cardinals.TV package?If you already have the MLB App downloaded, you’re one step closer to watching Cardinals baseball! Cardinals fans living within the Cardinals home television territory must purchase a Cardinals.TV subscription to stream Cardinals games. Only fans who live outside the Cardinals home market will be able to watch Cardinals games with the standard MLB.TV package.How do I know if I live in the Cardinals home territory?A map of the St. Louis Cardinals home television territory is below. You can also click here to enter your zip code.How can I get help navigating the MLB App?Please visit this link for questions regarding how to watch MLB.TV on iOS or Android devices, on a computer or with an app on your television.Can I watch Cardinals.TV through the ESPN app as part of MLB's new rights agreement?No. In 2026, in-market Cardinals.TV games will only be streamed in the MLB App.Can I authenticate access to Marlins games through the MLB App by using the credentials from my pay-TV provider?Yes, authentication is available for the 2026 season. Click here to get started or to see a full list of providersSatellite/Cable Viewing OptionsCan I still watch Cardinals games through my satellite or cable provider?Yes. Cardinals.TV will be available on a variety of cable and satellite providers. Specific providers and channel locations will be announced on Opening Day (March 26).What channel number will Cardinals.TV be on?Specific channel locations and cable and satellite providers will be announced on Opening Day (March 26). We expect that the channel locations will be located near other sports programming on your guide.How do I watch Cardinals baseball if I live outside of the local area?MLB.TV subscribers can continue to watch Cardinals games on MLB.TV outside of the local area.Can I authenticate access to Cardinals games through the MLB app by using the credentials from my pay-TV provider?Authenticating through your pay-TV provider login is not currently available. This is a future enhancement that will be available at a future date TBD.Does Cardinals.TV replace FanDuel Sports Network Midwest?Yes. Locally distributed Cardinals games are now produced and distributed by Major League Baseball under the name Cardinals.TV beginning with the 2026 season.Other QuestionsWho is calling games for Cardinals.TV?Cardinals.TV broadcasters will be include the return of play-by-play voice Chip Caray, analysts Brad Thompson and Mark Sweeney; along with reporters Jim Hayes and new for 2026, St. Louis native Dani Wexelman.MLB Blackout PolicyIn-market Cardinals.TV subscribers can stream ALL local Cardinals broadcasts with no blackouts. St. Louis Cardinals games streamed on Cardinals.TV may be subject to national exclusivities. Select regular season, special event, and Postseason games are unavailable on MLB.TV domestically and internationally due to certain Major League Baseball national exclusivities. Live audio of all 30 MLB teams is included with Cardinals.TV subscriptions.Fan SupportIf you are having issues accessing a game or have questions about your account you can visit our full online Support Page. You can also call our toll-free support (866.244.2291), email by clicking here, on Social @MLBFanSupport or via Virtual Assistant.https://cdn.onesignal.com/sdks/web/v16/OneSignalSDK.sw.js
